description: Trips, winemaking, improvised ice skating, moving a piano, making pottery, rescuing a television signal and reaching one last apple broaden the pair's handiwork from the home into travel, hobbies and seasonal projects.

s04e01.description: Car trouble ruins a planned camping trip, so Pat and Mat refuse to waste the preparations and recreate the outdoor experience indoors with whatever equipment is already at hand.

s04e02.description: With grapes ready for harvest, Pat and Mat try to mechanize both picking and winemaking, replacing repetitive manual work with a succession of home-built machines.

s04e03.description: An old pair of skates rekindles Mat's urge to go skating even though the weather is wrong, so Pat and Mat set about creating their own patch of ice.

s04e04.description: A newly acquired piano is far too large for the doorway. Pat and Mat therefore concentrate less on playing music than on inventing a way to get the instrument inside.

s04e05.description: After breaking their dishes, Pat and Mat decide to replace them by making pottery themselves, turning clay, a spinning wheel and improvised speed control into their next workshop challenge.

s04e06.description: A failing television signal threatens an important football match, sending Mat onto the roof to work on the aerial while Pat anxiously monitors whether each adjustment improves or destroys the picture.

s04e07.description: After the apple harvest, one stubborn fruit remains high in the tree. Pat and Mat devote far more engineering effort than the apple could possibly justify to bringing it within reach.
